column1: # The sequel world's room table (RoomTable has the format; docs/roadmap.md#stage-plan): one row per room of its network.

column4: Start. A landing on a frozen sea-wall: a shrine, a Lamplighter that talks (once), the Strongroom's locked door west.
Behind the Quay's locked door: a strength power-up on a dais, a scripture plate. A dead end.
The hub: a pool of open brine across the floor (swum or jumped), a shrine, a Chorister asleep; the iron east wall climbed (Mag-grip) to the high doorway on to the Hold.
Mag-grip on an altar; an iron wall to try it on. A dead end.
Rock walls only: the Harpoon on a cradle, two mooring rings up to the high ledge, the Strongroom key on it, the doorway on to the Weir (Harpoon). Back west is a drop off the Locks' wall.
A pool across the floor; the sluice gate on to the Beacon and its lever (a switch and its mechanism).
The goal: the cold lamp; reaching it ends the run (the end card).
